label: TP-Link EAP225-Wall
description: AC1200 wall-plate access point: one 10/100 uplink (PoE in), two 10/100 downlink ports and a third 10/100 port with PoE passthrough, dual-band Wi-Fi 5.
notes: Vendor figures from the TP-Link datasheet: 1x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet uplink port that accepts 802.3af/at as a powered device, 2x 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports, and 1x 10/100 Mbps port with PoE passthrough; 5 GHz up to 867 Mbps and 2.4 GHz up to 300 Mbps (IEEE 802.11n/g/b/ac). Note the uplink is fast Ethernet on this model - the Wi-Fi is faster than the wire, which is a real constraint when planning backhaul.
